paper.title: Ab initio calculation of real solids via neural network ansatz
paper.authors: Xiang Li, Zhe Li, Ji Chen

results.system_description: 3D homogeneous electron gas, N = 54 (27 up, 27 down), r_s = 0.5, simple cubic cell, Gamma point
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational Monte Carlo energy of the neural-network wave function (DeepSolid (FermiNet-type) "Net") at this N, r_s and cell, without finite-size correction or twist averaging.
results.notes: As printed (energy per electron, in Hartree). Madelung term: Ewald summation for lattice sums (text); Madelung inclusion not stated explicitly, but BF-DMC column equals Lopez Rios 2006 values and Pescia et al. compare directly -> consistent convention. Boundary: periodic; HEG at a single (Gamma) point - closed-shell configuration, TABC used only for graphene (Gamma not stated explicitly for HEG).
